SELECT t.Name, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.Course_ID) AS CourseCount
FROM teacher t
LEFT JOIN course_arrange ca ON t.Teacher_ID = ca.Teacher_ID
GROUP BY t.Teacher_ID, t.Name;
FINAL SQL:
SELECT t.Name, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.Course_ID) AS CourseCount
FROM teacher t
LEFT JOIN course_arrange ca ON t.Teacher_ID = ca.Teacher_ID
GROUP BY t.Teacher_ID, t.Name;
